flow.name: recipient-receive-order
flow.doc:description: Simulated downstream system: receives an order on POST /eip/recipients/{recipient}/orders and records it in that recipient's inbox; 404 for an unknown recipient, 503 from the warehouse for an ORD-WAREHOUSE-DOWN order.

logger.doc:name: WARN: Log warehouse unavailable
logger.message: #['Recipient warehouse is down (simulated) for orderId=' ++ payload.orderId ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

set-payload.doc:name: Set Unavailable Response
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { recipient: vars.vRecipient, orderId: payload.orderId, status: 'UNAVAILABLE' }]

os:store.doc:name: Record Order In Inbox
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { recipient: vars.vRecipient, orderId: payload.orderId, receivedAt: now() as String }]

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log order received
logger.message: #['Recipient ' ++ vars.vRecipient ++ ' received orderId=' ++ payload.orderId ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

set-payload.doc:name: Set Received Response
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { recipient: vars.vRecipient, orderId: payload.orderId, status: 'RECEIVED' }]

flow.name: recipient-get-order-notifications
flow.doc:description: GET /eip/orders/{orderId}/notifications: lists the recipients whose inbox holds the order.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var suffix = "|" ++ vars.vNotifiedOrderId --- { orderId: vars.vNotifiedOrderId, receivedBy: (payload filter ($ endsWith suffix) map ($[0 to (sizeOf($) - sizeOf(suffix) - 1)])) orderBy $ }
